# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +48
- **Deletions**: -28
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T14:17:29Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

  dmtools list                           # List available MCP tools

  dmtools <tool> --data '{"json"}'      # Execute with inline JSON
  dmtools <tool> --file params.json     # Execute with JSON file
  dmtools <tool> --verbose              # Execute with verbose output
  dmtools <tool> --debug                # Execute with debug output and error messages
  dmtools <tool> <<EOF                  # Execute with heredoc
  {"json": "data"}
  EOF

Examples:
  dmtools list
  dmtools doctor
  dmtools run job-config.json
  dmtools run codegenerator --param1 test
  dmtools jira_get_ticket DMC-479 summary,description
  dmtools jira_get_ticket --data '{"key": "DMC-479", "fields": ["summary"]}'

Environment Variables:
  DMTOOLS_INTEGRATIONS    Comma-separated list of integrations (jira,confluence,figma)

  The tool automatically loads environment variables from dmtools.env

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T14:17:29Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)

- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +48
- **Deletions**: -28
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T14:17:29Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

  dmtools <tool> --data '{"json"}'      # Execute with inline JSON
  dmtools <tool> --file params.json     # Execute with JSON file
  dmtools <tool> --verbose              # Execute with verbose output
  dmtools <tool> --debug                # Execute with debug output and error messages
  dmtools <tool> <<EOF                  # Execute with heredoc
  {"json": "data"}
  EOF

Examples:
  dmtools list
  dmtools doctor
  dmtools run job-config.json
  dmtools run codegenerator --param1 test
  dmtools jira_get_ticket DMC-479 summary,description
  dmtools jira_get_ticket --data '{"key": "DMC-479", "fields": ["summary"]}'

Environment Variables:
  DMTOOLS_INTEGRATIONS    Comma-separated list of integrations (jira,confluence,figma)

  The tool automatically loads environment variables from dmtools.env

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

  s.version       = '0.0.1'
  s.summary       = 'iOS/macOS Flutter bindings for wasm_run'
  s.license       = { :file => '../LICENSE' }
  s.homepage      = 'https://github.com/juancastillo0/wasm_run'
  s.authors       = { 'Juan Manuel Castillo' => '42351046+juancastillo0@users.noreply.github.com' }

  # This will ensure the source files in Classes/ are included in the native
  # builds of apps using this FFI plugin. Podspec does not support relative
  # paths, so Classes contains a forwarder C file that relatively imports
  # `../src/*` so that the C sources can be shared among all target platforms.
  s.source              = { :path => '.' }
  s.source_files        = 'Classes/**/*'
  s.public_header_files = 'Classes/**/*.h'
  # No s.vendored_frameworks (#1096 AC4): the macOS app resolves the
  # wasm_run FFI surface via dlsym on its OWN executable — Runner.xcodeproj

  # embedded dynamic wasm_run_flutter.framework (27 MB unpacked) was a
  # never-loaded fallback; vendoring it here is what put it in
  # Frameworks/. The XCFramework download block above STAYS — the static
  # archive inside it feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check.

  s.ios.deployment_target = '11.0'
  s.osx.deployment_target = '10.13'
end

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):

- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

The failure: the wasm_run_flutter pod target ("dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling" in EnforceBundling.o) references the `_wire_*`/frb symbols from the static library, but with `s.vendored_frameworks` removed, the pod target no longer links against the framework that provided those symbols. The `EnforceBundling` dummy references symbols that were previously satisfied by the vendored dynamic framework.

So the podspec change broke the pod target link. The fix: the podspec previously vendored the framework, which provided all frb symbols to the EnforceBundling dummy. Now we need the pod target to still link the static archive OR to stop referencing those symbols.

Pod::Spec.new do |s|
  s.name          = 'wasm_run_flutter'
  s.version       = '0.0.1'
  s.summary       = 'iOS/macOS Flutter bindings for wasm_run'
  s.license       = { :file => '../LICENSE' }
  s.homepage      = 'https://github.com/juancastillo0/wasm_run'
  s.authors       = { 'Juan Manuel Castillo' => '42351046+juancastillo0@users.noreply.github.com' }

  # This will ensure the source files in Classes/ are included in the native
  # builds of apps using this FFI plugin. Podspec does not support relative
  # paths, so Classes contains a forwarder C file that relatively imports
  # `../src/*` so that the C sources can be shared among all target platforms.
  s.source              = { :path => '.' }
  s.source_files        = 'Classes/**/*'
  s.public_header_files = 'Classes/**/*.h'
  # No s.vendored_frameworks (#1096 AC4): the macOS app resolves the
  # wasm_run FFI surface via dlsym on its OWN executable — Runner.xcodeproj
  # force_loads WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a
  # and exports the _wire_* symbols (CI verifies them per build). The
  # embedded dynamic wasm_run_flutter.framework (27 MB unpacked) was a
  # never-loaded fallback; vendoring it here is what put it in
  # Frameworks/. The XCFramework download block above STAYS — the static
  # archive inside it feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check.

  s.ios.deployment_target = '11.0'
  s.osx.deployment_target = '10.13'
end

# Pull Request Information

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI."

- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted

- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

The issue: `EnforceBundling.swift` calls `dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling()` — a C function defined in the static library (`libwasm_run_dart.a`), and also references a huge list of FRB symbols (`_drop_dart_object`, `_inflate_*`, `_new_*`, `_wire_*` presumably in the rest of the list). Previously the pod target linked the vendored framework (dynamic), which satisfied these symbols in the pod target itself. Now that `s.vendored_frameworks` is removed, the pod target builds `EnforceBundling.o` but nothing links the static archive into the pod target, so the pod target's link fails with undefined symbols.

Where do these symbols come from? The static archive `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` contains `dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling` and the frb-generated symbols. The app target force_loads that archive and exports the symbols (via `-Wl,-exported_symbol` or `FORCE_LOAD` linker flags in Runner.xcodeproj / xcconfig). At runtime, `DynamicLibrary.executable()` resolves them.

But the pod target (wasm_run_flutter.framework, a dynamic framework target built by Pods.xcodeproj) compiles EnforceBundling.swift which references the symbols at link time. With the vendored framework removed, the pod target has no source of those symbols → link error.

Hmm, actually in CocoaPods, `vendored_frameworks` are linked into every target that integrates the pod). The pod target itself would link the vendored framework so its own code (EnforceBundling) resolves symbols against it. The framework was a dynamic framework embedding libwasm_run_dart.a presumably.

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

The issue: `EnforceBundling.swift` calls `dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling()` — a C function defined in the static library (`libwasm_run_dart.a`), and also references a huge list of FRB symbols (`_drop_dart_object`, `_inflate_*`, `_new_*`, `_wire_*` presumably in the rest of the list). Previously the pod target linked the vendored framework (dynamic), which satisfied these symbols in the pod target itself. Now that `s.vendored_frameworks` is removed, the pod target builds `EnforceBundling.o` but nothing links the static archive into the pod target, so the pod target's link fails with undefined symbols.

Where do these symbols come from? The static archive `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` contains `dummy_method_to_enforce_bundling` and the frb-generated symbols. The app target force_loads that archive and exports the symbols (via `-Wl,-exported_symbol` or `FORCE_LOAD` linker flags in Runner.xcodeproj / xcconfig). At runtime, `DynamicLibrary.executable()` resolves them.

But the pod target (wasm_run_flutter.framework, a dynamic framework target built by Pods.xcodeproj) compiles EnforceBundling.swift which references the symbols at link time. With the vendored framework removed, the pod target has no source of those symbols → link error.

Wait — previously with `s.vendored_frameworks = "Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework"`, how did it work? Vendored frameworks aren't linked into the pod target itself by default... Actually vendored_frameworks ARE linked to the pod target (they're added to the pod target's frameworks phase? No — vendored_frameworks are linked to the targets that depend on the pod... Hmm, actually in CocoaPods, `vendored_frameworks` are linked into every target that integrates the pod). The pod target itself would link the vendored framework so its own code (EnforceBundling) resolves symbols against it. The framework was a dynamic framework embedding libwasm_run_dart.a presumably.

  # wasm_run FFI symbols live in a static library inside WasmRun.xcframework.
  # They are referenced only from Dart via dlsym (DynamicLibrary.executable()),
  # so the linker never pulls them in: force_load alone is not enough because
  # DEAD_CODE_STRIPPING=YES (Release default) still discards the unreferenced
  # code, and dlsym only sees exported symbols. Exporting a symbol makes it
  # both dlsym-visible AND a dead-strip root, so export every C-ABI symbol the
  # Dart bindings look up (wire_*/new_*/drop_*/…), derived from the archive
  # itself so the list stays in sync with the vendored package. Without this
  # the Release/TestFlight binary boots to a white screen. SRCROOT is the
  # macos/ directory, so ../../ walks up to the repo root where vendor/ lives.
  macos_slice = '$(SRCROOT)/../../vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a'
  macos_archive = File.expand_path('../../vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a', __dir__)
  ffi_symbols = `nm -gU -arch arm64 #{macos_archive}`.lines
    .map(&:split)
    .select { |cols| %w[T D S].include?(cols[1]) && cols[2] }
    .map { |cols| cols[2] }
    .uniq
    .grep(/^_(wire|new|drop|free|get|store|init|inflate|share)_/)
    .sort
  raise "no wasm_run FFI symbols found in #{macos_archive}" if ffi_symbols.empty?
  export_flags = ffi_symbols.map { |s| "-Wl,-exported_symbol,#{s}" }
  installer.aggregate_targets.each do |aggregate_target|
    aggregate_target.user_project.targets.each do |target|
      next unless target.name == 'Runner'
      target.build_configurations.each do |config|
        # Archive/install builds run `strip` per STRIP_STYLE. The default
        # "all" removes the dyld exports trie entirely, which kills the
        # dlsym-based wasm_run lookups at runtime — TestFlight white screen.
        # "non-global" (strip -x) keeps the trie intact.
        config.build_settings['STRIP_STYLE'] = 'non-global'
        ldflags = Array(config.build_settings['OTHER_LDFLAGS'] || ['$(inherited)']).dup
        # Drop stale wasm_run flags from earlier pod installs.
        ldflags.reject! { |f| f == '-force_load' || f.include?('wasm_run_dart.a') || f.start_with?('-Wl,-exported_symbol,') }
        ldflags << "-Wl,-force_load,#{macos_slice}"
        # Debug must NOT get -exported_symbol flags: giving any flips ld
        # into "export only these" mode, which hides the JIT entry point
        # (main) from the debug host — abort_could_not_find_entry_point
        # at launch. Debug exports all globals by default, so dlsym finds
        # the wire_* symbols without any flags.
        ldflags.concat(export_flags) unless config.name == 'Debug'
        config.build_settings['OTHER_LDFLAGS'] = ldflags
      end
    end
    aggregate_target.user_project.save
  end

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1227
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1227
- **Title**: feat(1096): mac size diet — wasm_run_flutter.framework + never-loaded assets, ratcheted
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `feat/1096-size-diet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +48
- **Deletions**: -28
- **Created**: 2026-10-04T13:54:04Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-04T14:17:29Z

## PR Description

Part of #1096 — slice 2: the cuts slice 1 explicitly deferred (AC4 + direction-3 analog on macOS, owner-decision items untouched). Budget-gate script unchanged; baselines reseeded onto the measured post-cut shape.

## Delivered

### AC4 — macOS app ships without `wasm_run_flutter.framework` (27.1 MB unpacked)
`vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/wasm_run_flutter.podspec`: `s.vendored_frameworks` removed. The embedded dynamic framework was a **never-loaded fallback**: the Dart FFI surface resolves via dlsym on the app's own executable — `Runner.xcodeproj` force_loads `WasmRun.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/libwasm_run_dart.a` and exports the `_wire_*` symbols (verified per build by the existing `wasm_run FFI symbol verification` step). `createLibraryImpl` (`vendor/wasm_run/lib/src/ffi/io.dart:50-56`) tries `DynamicLibrary.executable()` first on macOS and `_validateLibrary` checks exactly `wire_compile_wasm` — the symbol the CI gate asserts. So `WasmRunLibrary.setUp(override: false)` no-ops on the pruned build; **no Dart change, no boot-time dylib download**. The XCFramework cache/restore/download stays untouched — the static archive feeds the force_load and the Podfile symbol check (`Podfile:132-141`); `wasmrun_restore_budget_test` stays green (5/5).

### macOS flutter_assets diet (direction 3 analog, ~52 MB unpacked)
`build-macos.yml` Package step prunes, **before any codesign**:
- `flutter_assets/assets/wasm` — ~47 MB of WASI interpreter modules loaded exclusively through `WasiSandboxShell` (`env_factory_io.dart` routes desktops to the host `Process` shell; every `rootBundle.load('assets/wasm/…')` lives in the mobile-only shell — re-verified on current main). Mobile (iOS/Android) builds untouched — they keep the full set (backward-compat invariant).
- `flutter_assets/packages/js_widget_runtime/test` — 5.6 MB coach_anny.glb test fixture of the pub package, declared as package assets; nothing in the app references that path (grep over flutter_app/lib, packages, lib, bundled JS apps).

### Same fixture prune on every other shipped web shape (5.6 MB each)
`scripts/build_browser_ext.sh` (extension zip), `.github/workflows/pages.yml` (fa1.dev), `scripts/build_office_addin.sh` (outlook pane).

### AC1 ratchet — baselines reseeded onto the post-cut shape
Both `scripts/size_budget` floors rewritten from the **real v1.0.504 release artifacts** with the cuts applied (`--reseed`; script unchanged):
- mac zip: TOTAL 203,341,721 → 111,001,004 B unpacked (**−45.3%**); compressed auto-update zip 75.8 MB → 41.0 MB (**−46%**). DMG shrinks identically.
- extension: TOTAL 78,149,373 → 72,527,489 B (**−7.1%**); compressed 28.3 → 26.4 MB.

Gate proofs (all against the committed floors):
- cut mac zip vs pre-PR baseline: PASS (TOTAL −45.3%, no line grew) — the cut ships green even before the reseed lands
- pre-cut v1.0.504 mac zip vs new floor: **FAIL** — 4 NEW >5% lines (`wasm_run_flutter.framework` 27.1 MB, `python.wasm` 30.4 MB, `coreutils.wasm` 8.4 MB, `coach_anny.glb` 5.6 MB), TOTAL +83.2%
- pre-cut extension vs new floor: **FAIL** — glb NEW >5%, TOTAL +7.8%
- tampered cut zip (main binary +10%): **FAIL** (GREW)
- `size_manifest.py selftest`: 11/11 PASS
- per-line shapes of both cut zips otherwise byte-identical to the shipped releases (only the cut lines + engine-bump drift between v1.0.493 baselines and v1.0.504)

### Not needed (verified, deliberately no diff)
- No `wasm_setup_io.dart` change: with the framework gone, `setUp(override:false)` → `isReachable()` → `executable()` succeeds (static link + exported symbols, CI-gated) → early return. The download path never runs on release or dev builds (force_load applies to both).
- iOS podspec untouched — iOS vendors its own framework slice and statically links it.

## Remaining (owner decisions / later slices, unchanged from the issue)
- AC5: iOS lite flavor vs accept-35 MB (LiteRT/Gemma on-device stack, 35 MB iOS / 45 MB macOS)
- OQ3: `--wasm` (skwasm) spike; App.framework 89–92 MB code-size audit (direction 6)
- mac canvaskit rev-dir inner mirror (web-only shape; needs network trace before cutting — extension/web floors already carry it)
- Known gate floor: NEW-line share is 5% of TOTAL — a future single line under that (e.g. a small asset) regrows silently; the TOTAL line still covers aggregate drift.

## CI note
Per fleet policy this PR does not dispatch or rerun workflows; SM schedules CI.

  dmtools <tool> --verbose              # Execute with verbose output
  dmtools <tool> --debug                # Execute with debug output and error messages
  dmtools <tool> <<EOF                  # Execute with heredoc
  {"json": "data"}
  EOF

Examples:

  dmtools doctor

        # into "export only these" mode, which hides the JIT entry point
        # (main) from the debug host — abort_could_not_find_entry_point
